description: Create a vendor bill. Accepts vendor/account/department names (will lookup IDs automatically). Note: DepartmentRef is header-level only — for multi-department splits, create separate bills (one per department). Returns bill details and a link to view in QuickBooks.

ap_account.description: Accounts Payable account name or number (optional, defaults to standard AP). Only Accounts Payable-type accounts are matched.

department_id.description: Header-level department/location ID (use if you already know it, otherwise use department_name)

department_name.description: Header-level department/location name (e.g., '20358', 'Cotati'). Will be looked up to get ID.

draft.description: If true, validate and show preview without creating (default: true)

lines.description: Array of expense line items. Provide account_name OR account_id (name preferred). Optionally provide class_name OR class_id for per-line Class tracking, and customer_name OR customer_id to attribute the line to a customer.

account_id.description: Account ID (use if you already know it, otherwise use account_name)

account_name.description: Account name (e.g., 'Alarm', '6123'). Will be looked up to get ID.

class_id.description: Class ID (use if you already know it, otherwise use class_name)

class_name.description: Class name for this line (e.g., '5614', 'Parent:Child'). Will be looked up to get ID. QBO Class tracking, distinct from header-level Department/Location.

customer_id.description: Customer ID (use if you already know it, otherwise use customer_name)

customer_name.description: Customer or project this line is attributed to (auto-resolved to ID). Sets AccountBasedExpenseLineDetail.CustomerRef. Bill lines accept a customer only — the vendor is the header vendor_name. The line is marked NotBillable; these tools attribute cost, they do not queue it for re-invoicing.

vendor_id.description: Vendor ID (use if you already know it, otherwise use vendor_name)

vendor_name.description: Vendor display name (e.g., 'Simplisafe', 'PG&E'). Will be looked up to get ID.

name: create_bill
